title: Mob Effects Modifier
description: A GUI-configurable mob effect system that lets you filter specific mobs, assign effects on spawn, or schedule timed effect updates.
body:
# Mob Effects Modifier ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg) 一个 Minecraft Forge 模组，允许你自定义生物的药水效果。可以让生物**生成时自带效果**，或者**定时添加/移除效果**，所有配置通过游戏内 GUI 完成，无需编辑配置文件。 > A Minecraft Forge mod that lets you customize mob potion effects. Give mobs **effects on spawn** or **add/remove effects on a timer** — all configured through an in-game GUI, no file editing required. ## ✨ 功能 | Features - **个性化配置生物的效果** — 使用 `/effectmenu` 开启生物效果配置菜单（需要管理员权限） - **生成自带效果** — 生物生成时自动获得你指定的药水效果 - **定时添加/移除** — 按自定义间隔给生物添加或移除效果 - **灵活目标选择** — 支持全部生物、白名单、黑名单三种模式 - **分组管理** — 配置项支持分组，使用 `/effectmenu group ` 可以统一开启或者关闭某一组配置 - **游戏内 GUI 配置** — 搜索、选择、编辑全部在游戏内完成 - **每个配置独立文件** — 保存在 `config/mob_effects_modifier/` 下，方便分享和版本管理 - **服务端权威** — 所有配置存储在服务端，多人游戏统一生效 - **热重载** — `/effectmenu reload` 重新加载配置，无需重启
- **Custom Mob Effects** — Open the config menu with `/effectmenu` (requires admin permission) - **Effects on Spawn** — Mobs automatically gain your specified potion effects when they spawn - **Timed Add/Remove** — Add or remove effects from mobs at custom intervals - **Flexible Targeting** — Supports ALL mobs, WHITELIST, and BLACKLIST modes - **Group Management** — Organize configs into groups; use `/effectmenu group ` to enable/disable an entire group at once - **In-Game GUI** — Search, select, and edit everything without leaving the game - **Per-Config Files** — Stored under `config/mob_effects_modifier/`, easy to share and version-control - **Server-Authoritative** — All configs live on the server; everyone on a multiplayer server uses the same settings - **Hot Reload** — `/effectmenu reload` reloads configs without restarting --- ## 📷 截图 --- ## 📄 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026
